subject: FintechCo — Post-call: API auth & key management (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: FintechCo — Post-call: API auth & key management (next steps)

Hi Alice — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking us through FintechCo's integration goals and constraints. Quick recap from our side, plus proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (from today’s discovery):
- Primary use case: embedding-based semantic search + reranking for support tickets and transaction logs.
- Expected traffic: ~2000 requests/minute at peak for embedding lookups, generation calls for summaries at ~300 r/min.
- Auth: you mentioned a mix of service accounts (server-to-server) + OAuth/JWT for user-scoped calls. Key rotation is monthly via your KMS.
- Security: SOC 2 in progress; need audit-log retention and KMS compatibility for any hosted keys.
- Platform constraints: prefer hosted API initially, but may require VPC/private deployment for regulated flows later.

Open / action items we discussed:
1) SDK + sample code for our typical server-side flow (service account auth + short-lived tokens).
2) Clarify how Redwood can integrate with your KMS (supported providers, rotation hooks).
3) Routing/structured output: confirm embeddings + reranker pipeline and whether you need tool-calling/structured output for downstream systems.
4) Security evidences: example audit log format and retention options.

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll share our Auth overview + integration checklist (attached).
- Schedule a technical workshop with Ethan (Solutions Engineer) to go through SDK samples, KMS compatibility, and routing/embedding questions — can you confirm availability next Wed/Thu?
- FintechCo to confirm throughput profile (peak qps, average seq lengths) and whether PII demands will push towards private deployment.

Attachments: redwood-auth-overview.pdf, integration-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and the sample SDK snippet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
https://redwood.ai
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: FintechCo Security <security@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo — Post-call: API auth & key management (next steps)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few answers inline: 

- Auth: we use GCP KMS and service accounts for all backend-to-backend traffic. We also have an OAuth flow for user-scoped features (OIDC/JWT). For server-to-server, we currently mint short-lived keys (7d) via a central rotation process, but we’re open to adjusting schedules.
- Rotation: monthly rotation is standard, but we can do more frequent rotation if needed. We maintain rotation logs in our internal audit system and can share sample output.
- Throughput: initial pilot is lower (~200 r/min embeddings, 50 gen r/min) but expected to scale to the numbers Marissa mentioned within 2 quarters.
- KMS compatibility: we’d like details on how Redwood’s hosted offering handles customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) vs. Redwood-managed keys. Also need to know if short-lived tokens / service-account impersonation is supported.

Requests: 
1) Please send SDK snippets for server-side token exchange + example of using short-lived credentials with the Redwood SDK.
2) Can Ethan run the workshop next Thursday (10/22) at 10am PT? That works for our engineering and security leads.
3) Please attach any relevant security docs (audit log samples, SOC 2 timeline).

Appreciate it — attaching a short internal note for our security team.

Regards,
Alice Johnson
Director of Engineering | FintechCo
alice.johnson@fintechco.com
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: FintechCo — Post-call: API auth & key management (next steps)

Thanks Marissa — happy to run the technical workshop. I can cover: SDK server-side flows, short-lived token exchange, sample KMS integrations (GCP/AWS/Azure), and a live demo of embeddings + reranker wiring.

Questions I need from FintechCo before the call: 
- Expected avg/95th token lengths for generation calls (helps pick batching/quantization config).
- Do they require BYOK (customer-managed keys) for model calls or only for audit/encryption at rest?
- Any egress/VPC peering constraints (if they’re considering Private deployment)?

I’ve attached a short plain-text sample request file (sdk-sample-requests.txt) that I’ll expand into a live code walkthrough.

—Ethan
Ethan Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.ai

Alice — great, thanks for the quick responses and for confirming Thursday 10/22 at 10am PT. I’ve booked the workshop and added the invite here: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/8f3b2c5d — please accept when convenient.

- Marissa: I’ll upload the HubSpot deal and send a mutual action plan with dates (HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FTCH-2026-0927).
